defect: Continual redefinition is stated three times in six lines, sharing the root 'redefin': 'continually redefined by decentralized consensus', 'an ongoing process of redefinition', and 'indeterminate and continually redefined'. None adds a register the previous one lacked.
fix: Cuts two; keeps the mechanism inside the transformation list and replaces the others with register-distinct lines (collectors reading the set; canon).
also_fixed: Rewrote the canon simile as a grammatical continuation.
relation_definition: Repetition in synonyms mistaken for emphasis: restatements that add no new register, only another word for the last one.
evidence_text: Inscribed on Bitcoin, continually redefined by decentralized consensus.
Chang initiated an ongoing process of redefinition.
Like words that accrue significance on entering the scarce set of meanings we call canon.
